about: HAND-MAINTAINED. Every build that has ever assembled wrong from the packs (a baker or recipe bug). Add one whenever a model bug is found, with a `why` saying what went wrong. The suite (npm run test:models) assembles each from the packs and compares it with the recipe, and the baker adds them to every platform's analysis. A part id that no longer exists, or a build the gunsmith would prune, fails the test as STALE: map it to the current equivalent here (and say so in `note`).

cases.why: assembled wrong earlier (listed by the model owner; the reason was not recorded): magnifier + riser-clamped optic + railmount on the integrally suppressed MP5SD
assembled wrong earlier (reason not recorded): fully loaded SR-25 with a 16 inch barrel, a compensator, two lights and a foregrip
cases.note: was handguard hg.ar.1 (0.36 m), which no longer fits the 16 inch barrel: mapped to oem.hg.ar.10, what the gunsmith put there; round 3 (barrels drawn from their length, a 16 inch one shows less) oem.hg.ar.10 no longer fits it either: now hg.ar.4 (0.32 m)
